psnprofiles.note: Official names, descriptions and grades; agrees with Exophase on all 55

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.timing: Last — pops automatically with the final trophy.
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks by itself. Expect around 200 hours in total, most of it on the 100% checklist for A Long Road. Everything is single-player, so no online play is ever needed.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It is one of the first missions you play, so this pops early and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.timing: Chapter 1 — pops at the start of Chapter 2.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The trophy actually pops once you have played the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag? — so do not worry if it does not appear the moment the chapter ends.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. It is awarded as Chapter 3 begins, after Welcome to Vice City.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. It arrives after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. A story trophy that cannot be missed — just keep playing the story.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the last mission of the story in Chapter 5. Free roam carries on after the credits, so you can clean up everything else afterwards. There is no mission replay, but no trophy depends on how you play a mission.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 story mission. It pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. It pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play in Chapter 4. It pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners in Chapter 4. It pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. It pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. It pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.timing: After the credits — the longest stretch, around 100 hours.
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion: open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story. The checklist shows up after the credits, but everything you did before already counts, and nothing on it is missable. In full it wants every robbery, every underwater discovery, a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge, all drone races and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks, plus a share of the rest: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land any 250 of the 397 stunts, in any mix: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Flying under bridges is the quickest way to pile them up, and the optional challenge on each stunt is not needed. Track the count at Progress > Activities > Stunts; the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race (car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race) and a stunt. Progress > Activities shows what is left, and most of them come naturally while you play.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.timing: Any time — ranges are open in free roam.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge: 42 golds across 12 ranges. Ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough here, but the 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so you may as well finish each location while you are there.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 to choose from, and winning the same race again does not count.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After you meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon. Play through his fishing quests and beat him in his challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Reach the end of any one arcade game. Three of them — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind — are on the TV at home, and the fourth, Bang For Your Buck, is on arcade cabinets around Leonida.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.timing: Chapter 3 onward; still there after the story.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's last quest. His quests are Lucia-only and start in Chapter 3, when he texts her an address in Belville. Do all five in order — Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the last one awards the trophy. They are still there after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.timing: Chapter 1 onward; Kenton texts Jason again later.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's last job. Kenton (green KR icon in Key Lento) hires you in Chapter 1 to recover treasure from 7 shipwrecks: dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig it up. He disappears after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again later, so you can finish it then. Track it under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.timing: Chapter 2 onward; still available after the story.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last job. His five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break; the fifth, Hometown Heroes, unlocks the trophy. They stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.timing: Any time — all stay available after the story.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; the quest lines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. The remaining qualifying strands are still being confirmed, so check the trophy's progress counter in your trophy list. None of them are needed for 100%, and all of them stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's last delivery. Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission that gets you the Key Cloner (Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS). Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City (RK icon); scan cars with the WAiNK app to see if they are on the list, and hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the best places to look. Cars in better condition pay more.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's last job. Jason-only: after Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, Tyrone has you destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City. Once enough are gone, his last job, Shut Down the Labs, awards the trophy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.timing: CHAPTER 1 — one meditation disappears after the chapter. Do it now.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every Meditation Spot until the counter reaches 18; meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice. The last one needs both characters, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. THE MISSABLE ONE: in Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony and accept her meditation. It is gone after Chapter 1, and it is not confirmed yet whether the trophy needs it — so do not skip it.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. His hunting quests start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: he texts Jason, and Veteran Hunted in Lummox County kicks things off. Hunt the animals on his Target Decks (purple icons) and bring them back as Jason; a clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required. Which animal triggers the trophy is not confirmed yet; the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets — you do not need all of them. The Collections section of the Progress menu shows how close each set is.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up on the D-pad, then R1 / RB). Any 100 count, from the 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges; Progress > Challenges marks finished ones with a tick. Many complete themselves while you play, and the 100% checklist needs 70, so this one comes along the way.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.timing: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, with your partner.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Possible once both characters are together (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2): call your partner (hold Right on the D-pad, then Triangle / Y), get a 4-star Wanted Level and escape — it only counts once you are out of the red heat zone. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters well, and bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so it often unlocks there.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while you are still wanted (flashing red and blue). Go in with body armor, sticky bombs and healing items. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3) are close together. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to appear after the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app — you do not need to drive them. Stand next to a busy road and scan passing traffic. The 100% checklist needs 200 base models, so you will get this anyway.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.timing: Any time — gang operations work best.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (click both sticks while aiming). It only lasts a few seconds, so fill your Focus first (eat, drink or wash up at home; Adrenaline makes it last longer) and use an assault rifle. Gang operation thugs work well; cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.timing: Any time — free roam at the airport.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: steal one of the big passenger jets docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge (planes parked out on the airfield do not count). Back it out, take off and get about 1 km away from the airport. Gates E3 and E4 are the easiest: drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station on the southwest island of Mariana County (the tanks are at the south end of the base) and take out enemies from inside it until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.timing: Chapter 3 onward, after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 give you the Snap Gun: use it on a jewelry store's locked back door (kicking it in sets off the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room and empty the safe without being spotted. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City works well.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults open up with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…: follow a security van to its bank and get into the vault while it is open. The haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner. Vaults always give 4 stars: escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles. 5 of the 8 vaults are enough here, but the 100% checklist needs all 8, and each pays up to $205,000. Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.timing: Any time — free roam, or with a vault.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Robbing a bank vault (see Maximum Withdrawal) counts, as long as you then escape the red heat zone or get to a Pay 'n' Spray. Before that, you can box in an armored truck, put a sticky bomb on its back doors, blow them open and get away.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: clear the fog from the whole map. The quickest way is by plane, flying over every dark patch.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal gang operation (yellow map icons) from each of the 9 gangs; Progress > Gangs keeps count. The 100% checklist needs all 39.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.timing: Any time — free roam on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach in Vice City. The exact steps are not confirmed yet — no guide has verified the precise spot at launch — so treat the description's hint as the lead and check the sources for updates.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The description points to crashing a car out through the window of a vehicle showroom, in classic style. The exact steps are not confirmed yet — the guides list the hint and no verified method at launch.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation, first marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2. Take its three valuables — the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table and the safe in the northeast hallway (bring sticky bombs). The trophy pops once you lose the police. You do not need all three in one visit, but the robbery takes a long time to come back.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia (Jason & Lucia > Strength in the pause menu). Work out at fitness clubs (Map > Activities) with your partner along: training one trains the other too. After the story you can also train at home.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Most players get it without trying; turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI to watch the count. Do not push towards the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt. The exact steps are not confirmed yet — the guides list the description's hint and no verified method at launch.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Expect a strange event or Easter egg somewhere in Leonida. The exact steps are not confirmed yet — the guides list the description's hint and no verified method at launch.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.timing: Any time — free roam, from a vehicle.
trophies.guide: The description points to knocking people down with a melee attack from a vehicle — a melee drive-by. The exact steps are not confirmed yet — the guides list the description's hint and no verified method at launch.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) in Chapter 3 gets you the Dye Pack Jammer. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to fences; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. It is a running total, so the robberies for 100% get you there.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a running total of $100,000 across every kind of shop. Guns, car mods and tattoos use it up fastest.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy the 8 garages for sale in the Vice City Real Estate phone app (available after Daily Driver in Chapter 2), about $160,000 in total. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Moses' Chapter 2 mission gets you the app: take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray them and register them. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones. You need free garage space (see Little Boxes) and each registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
